title: Allard's regularity theorem (graph form, bounded generalized mean curvature)
statement: Let n ≥ 1 and k ≥ 0. For every ε > 0 there are δ₀ > 0 and γ ∈ (0, 1] with the following property. Let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be any set, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep) with weight μ_R = θHⁿ⌞M (R.measure), W ⊆ U open, κ ∈ ℝ, ρ > 0, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, and H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ_R-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x, such that v(M, θ) has generalized mean curvature H in W: R.firstVariation X = ∫_M θ div_M X dHⁿ = −∫⟨X, H⟩ dμ_R for every C¹ compactly supported vector field X with tsupport X ⊆ W (div_M X(x) = trace(p_{T_xM}∘DX(x)), T_xM the approximate tangent plane of M). If the closed ball B̄_ρ(z) ⊆ W, z ∈ spt μ_R, μ_R(B̄_ρ(z)) ≤ (1 + δ₀)ω_nρⁿ and κρ ≤ δ₀, then there are linear isometries ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w, and u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^k with u(0) = 0, u of class C¹ on the open ball B_{γρ}(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ with ‖Du(v)‖ ≤ ε there, such that spt μ_R ∩ B_{γρ}(z) = {z + ιv + ι'u(v) : |v| < γρ} ∩ B_{γρ}(z) (open balls). This is Allard's Regularity Theorem (Simon Ch. 5, 5.2 with Remark 5.3) for integer multiplicity varifolds with bounded generalized mean curvature, i.e. the case p = 2n of hypotheses 5.1. (The frozen Lean type is character-identical to that of DAG node root.density_one_implies_regular-a1.epsilon_regularity-a1.allard_graph-a1, not yet comparator-accepted; it is declared here under the fresh name Submission.dimred_cdg_allard_bounded_curvature_graph.)
